answer: The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 217 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the ivory. Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the ferrous queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. The deposit is 15 dollars a seat. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
